outcome: The native job-application report Loop now rejects incomplete requests before drafting, enforces reader-facing candidate composition against the frozen result, and exposes a final PDF only through one aggregate fail-closed settlement receipt.

responsibility_decisions.reason: Request readiness, candidate report composition, and final PDF settlement are lifecycle responsibilities of this single document-production Loop. No separate cross-domain control decision, reusable port contract, or independently governed lifecycle was evidenced.
responsibility_decisions.reason_for_no_extraction: The new schemas, validators, examples, policy, and operating guidance are cohesive parts of the existing Loop and have no proven consumer outside its outcome boundary.

material_changes: A complete request preflight now validates protected rubric, source provenance, question planning, applicant-owned voice evidence, publication policy, and the mandatory five-set PDF profile before drafting.
Protected runtime-profile rules are shared by profile and full validation so a reduced request cannot pass one entrypoint while failing another.
Report composition now proves exact answer, strategy, and criterion-comment parity with the frozen result and requires descriptive candidate titles and candidate-specific expert review.
A typed run bundle binds every required runtime record and file, and one aggregate checker re-runs cross-record, composition, render, text-layer, and final-PDF checks before settlement.
Individual checker success and handwritten validation summaries no longer qualify a run as complete.

findings: Existing job-application reference and knowledge pages fail current repository knowledge-document requirements.
Repository-wide artifact portfolio, semantic graph, and reusable-artifact inventory snapshots are stale relative to the current dirty worktree.
repository_fitness.reason: These documents and fan-in generated indexes are outside the exact native owner and include unrelated user changes. Repository instructions reserve fan-in index updates for an integration owner.

limitations: The aggregate checker proves deterministic contract and artifact consistency; applicant confirmation and a material final-use decision remain human-owned.

The report composer remains adaptable rather than canonical. Its visible output is constrained through the profile and composition checks so company- and question-specific layouts can vary without weakening settlement.
No prior report was regenerated or rewritten by this hardening operation.

optional_follow_up.condition: Consider extracting a shared publication-settlement component only after another document domain demonstrates the same control decision, ports, and lifecycle independently of job-application semantics.
